entries.title: React booking component pack.
entries.notes: Capture the React adapter runtime with Theme Inertia Bookings installed and the labelled booking request form visible.
entries.useCase: A buyer confirms the React pack renders the page, widgets, and booking request contract.

entries.title: React themed booking services.
entries.notes: Capture React-rendered service cards and appointment CTAs from the themed component pack.
entries.useCase: A buyer verifies the React adapter covers the marketing sections, not only the booking form.

entries.title: React booking slot loading state.
entries.notes: Capture the public request form while available slots are loading or refreshing.
entries.useCase: A buyer checks that async slot selection has an understandable React loading state.

entries.title: React booking validation state.
entries.notes: Capture validation feedback on required customer fields and service/slot selection.
entries.useCase: A buyer confirms the React pack presents booking errors without relying on placeholders.

entries.title: React booking mobile layout.
entries.notes: Capture the React booking request page at a mobile viewport with labels and CTA visible.
entries.useCase: A buyer verifies the React component pack works for phone-based appointment requests.
